claims.claim: Bounded pytest short-test-summary scan parses beyond 65,536 characters and handles large fixtures while preserving authentic tail failure identities.
Verification summary combines nonempty stdout and stderr streams to expose lawful stderr-derived failure identities without raw reframing loss.
Safe failure detail exposes at most 32 failed-node identities in observed order, caps scan accumulation at 128 records, and honestly reflects truncation for >=33 records.
Explicit unavailable status is returned for unsupported format, absent, malformed, or truncated summaries missing a valid closing footer line.
All failure projections withhold pytest parameters, tracebacks, private paths, and secrets, emitting only allowlisted test identities and error types.
Backward compatibility is preserved for V1/V2 decoders, fixed remote blob reading for cat-file in legacy contamination tests, and aligned Brain Sync task revision bindings.
